title: Abu Dhabi Hospital
hero.text: Specialised rehabilitation and extended care, delivered through structured clinical pathways and multidisciplinary expertise.

text: Cambridge Hospital Abu Dhabi is a key facility within the Cambridge Hospital network in the UAE, supporting patients who require post-acute care, rehabilitation, long term care and extended medical support within a structured hospital environment.

The facility is designed for patients whose recovery continues beyond acute treatment and who require a higher level of coordination, monitoring and therapeutic support than conventional discharge pathways can provide.
